# Express.co.uk

> > Express.co.uk is a UK news and entertainment platform offering breaking news, royal family coverage, celebrity updates, and a comprehensive collection of free online puzzle games.

The Daily Express digital platform combines traditional journalism covering UK politics, royal family news, and celebrity stories with an extensive gaming portal featuring daily puzzles like Crusader Crossword, Sudoku, Solitaire, and Word Wheel. The site serves as both a news destination and casual gaming platform for UK audiences.
